title: Mamelao's seedchecker
description: Instantly cycle through predefined Minecraft seeds with hotkeys and automated commands. Designed for seed checking, testing, and speedrunning workflows.
body:
# Mamelao's Seedchecker ## Tool to speedup checking seeds This mod loads a list of seeds which lets check seeds even faster. * No more manual searching ## How to use Download the mod, and follow this tutorial: www.youtube.com/watch?v=RpN94a2q8JI In the mods folder put the .jar file you installed (you should also have fabric api)
Click i (can be changer) to load the next seed in the list.
Put the seeds in .minecraft/config/seeds.txt
Every time you load a seed it gets removed from seeds.txt ## Planned * Initial commands - Put in command(s) you want to run when entering a world * Block counter - Show the amount of blocks of some kind around you to look for buildings * Loading world beforehand - Instead of waiting for worlds to load every time, they get loaded in the background * HUD with useful information ## License This mod uses a MIT License. Also thanks to my friend Samixaro and my aunt for german translations
